title: qr-graph impact line
description: One URI the invalidation reaches through the declared graph, breadth-first, each reached once by its shortest path. Follow `by` back to the start to explain the line.

via.description: `target`: the URI asked about. `refresh`/`purge`: a target of the write method asked about. `embed`: embeds `by`.

cached.description: Whether the resource declares a cache at all. A child's tags reach its parent only from a child that ran with an ETag or Surrogate-Key, so an `embed` line whose `by` is not cached is a dependency the cache does not track (for a donut page, a hole rendered per request).

source.description: file:line; null for a URI no scanned resource serves.
